changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwencounterassigntobed AS SELECT eab.id, eab.encounter_id, eab.patient_id, eab.room_id, eab.bed_id, eab.department_id, eab.admission_reason, eab.assigned_at, eab.released_at, eab.is_active, eab.created_date, eab.created_by, eab.last_modified_by, eab.last_modified_date FROM public.encounter_assign_to_bed eab;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwencounterassigntobed TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwencounterassigntobed FROM report_user;
